supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of v.rwong at 13:45:05 UTC by lena.ward, followed two seconds later by adding that account to the Vendors group.

The account name and Vendors-group addition match the organization's stated help-desk process for temporary accounts, and the evidence does not show an administrator-group addition as part of the recorded creation sequence.
The account-creation event's subject logon ID matches a domain-controller network logon for lena.ward from WS-LWARD-01 recorded about four minutes earlier.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:20 to 14:00 UTC because of a collection outage; this overlaps the account-creation activity. Proxy coverage was reported as available outside that window.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the business request or approval for v.rwong, the intended account expiration, or whether the account was later used.
The recorded creation and group-addition events do not establish the account's complete group memberships or effective privileges.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream started on WS-LWARD-01; Google Drive is an unapproved cloud-storage service in the supplied environment context. This does not by itself determine whether the alerted account creation was malicious. (T248-00055, T248-00056, T248-00057)

lena.ward initiated an RDP session from WS-LWARD-01 to FILE-SUN-01 and logged on there. This is outside the stated remote-administration practice, which specifies WS-IDOYLE-01; the records do not establish that the session involved administration or that it was related to v.rwong. (T248-00007, T248-00010, T248-00011)
